turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit down, sit down. Today we are doing subtraction. Okay?
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: First sum. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Do it in your notebook. Rabi, what did you get?
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Thirty five? No, no, Ravi, that is wrong. Next. Arjoon, you tell.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: The answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Everybody say it. Twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: See, I told you yesterday also. You borrow from the tens. You borrow from the tens! Listen properly. Borrow from the tens, then subtract.
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Okay, next one. Sixty three minus twenty eight. Mina, quickly.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Thirty six? Meena, you are counting wrongly again. It is thirty five. Write thirty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Everyone understood? Thumbs up if you understood. Good. Okay, close your books now.
turns.label: check_whole_class
